## History

Jem is a young child who grows as his family outgrows their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). Following the death of Captain Jim and the success of his life-book, Jem's parents, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), decide to purchase the larger [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to better accommodate their growing family and Gilbert's medical practice. Jem and his family eventually pack up their belongings and leave the house of dreams to relocate to their new home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P2](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P3](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P7](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0007), +104 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--jem.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) is Jem's mother. As part of her growing family, Jem prompts his parents to purchase a larger home in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), known as the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place. Jem is carried along as [Anne](../character/anne.md) bids an emotional farewell to their original house of dreams and relocates to their new residence.

- Child of — mother of Jem  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P8](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P32](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0032), +2 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--jem.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is Jem's father. Due to his expanding medical practice and growing family after Jem's birth, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) decides to purchase the larger [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) property in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen). He facilitates the family's transition from their original house of dreams to this new home.

- Child of — father  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P34](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024)</sub>
